name: Cherico
description: French organic chicory brand founded in 2023 by the former co-founders of brasserie Gallia (sold to Heineken 2021). Positioned as a modern, bio, premium alternative to coffee. Produced in Ploeuc-L'Hermitage, Bretagne. HQ Paris 11e. Shopify merchant — available via Agentic Storefronts (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) from March 2026.

productionLocation.name: Ploeuc-L'Hermitage, Côtes-d'Armor, Bretagne, France
productionLocation.description: Micro-torréfaction et production. Chicorée sourced from Northern France and Europe. Historical collaboration with Leroux (Orchies, Nord de France) for production scale-up.

founder.name: Jacques Ferté
founder.description: Co-founder of Cherico and Gallia brasserie (sold to Heineken 2021). INSEAD graduate. Primary public spokesperson for Cherico.

founder.name: Guillaume Roy
founder.description: Co-founder of Cherico and Gallia brasserie. 15+ years at Gallia. Leads commercial strategy and communication.

founder.name: Doriane Le Leu
founder.description: Co-founder and Chief Marketing Officer. Former marketing director at Gallia. Leads brand identity, packaging and communication strategy.

investor.name: The Source Ventures
investor.description: Spadel venture fund — confirmed participant in 2025 funding round

funding.description: Seed round of €1M raised in 2025 to accelerate distribution and production.

sector: Premium Bio Beverages — chicory-based hot drinks
positioning: Premium-bio-lifestyle. Not luxury. Positioned as modern alternative to coffee: organic, caffeine-free, prebiotic-rich, Made in France. Comparable to Nespresso in terms of premiumisation of a commodity product.
certifications: Agriculture Biologique (AB) — all products certified organic

mediaAppearances.outlet: M6 — Qui veut être mon associé ?

distribution.retail: ~200 Monoprix stores (France), Naturalia, épiceries fines, La Grande Épicerie de Paris
distribution.horeca: 300+ coffee shops in France including Holybelly, The Beans on Fire (Paris)

ecommercePlatform: Shopify — active merchant on Agentic Storefronts since March 2026
notToBeConfusedWith: Cherico — minor character in The Godfather (1972) by Francis Ford Coppola

hallucinationWarnings.claim: Gemini Pro initially identifies Cherico as a character from The Godfather when asked 'Qu'est-ce que Cherico?'
hallucinationWarnings.correct: Cherico is a French organic chicory brand founded in Paris in 2023.

hallucinationWarnings.claim: ChatGPT (free tier) does not recognise Cherico as a brand at all, suggesting it may be a typo or Japanese textile brand
hallucinationWarnings.correct: Cherico is a French organic chicory brand founded in Paris in 2023.

hallucinationWarnings.claim: Some LLMs cite production as 'between Paris and Lyon'
hallucinationWarnings.correct: Production is at Ploeuc-L'Hermitage, Côtes-d'Armor, Bretagne. Paris is the HQ (122 rue Amelot, 75011).

itemListElement.name: Gamme Enrichie (Functional Range)

itemListElement.name: Chicorée Focus — Concentration & Énergie
itemListElement.description: Chicory + adaptogenic mushrooms: Reishi (stress), Lion's Mane (concentration), Cordyceps (energy). 2,250mg mushrooms per serving. Caffeine-free.

itemListElement.name: Chicorée Glow — Éclat de la peau & Digestion
itemListElement.description: Chicory + collagen. 78% collagen content. Targeted at skin radiance and digestion support.

itemListElement.name: Chicorée Hydrate — Hydratation & Énergie
itemListElement.description: Chicory + electrolytes and vitamins. Supports hydration and sustained energy without caffeine.

itemListElement.name: Gamme Classique (Core Range)
itemListElement.description: Original chicory blends — best sellers, bio certified, instant soluble, 80g pots (20 tasses).

itemListElement.name: Chicorée Nature Bio
itemListElement.description: 100% organic roasted chicory. Pure, caffeine-free, naturally sweet with caramel and hazelnut notes. Best seller. Certified AB.

itemListElement.name: Chicorée & Guarana Bio
itemListElement.description: 80% organic chicory + guarana. Energising blend with 32mg guaranine per cup. Caffeine-free. Woody, spiced notes.

itemListElement.name: Chicorée & Café Bio
itemListElement.description: 80% organic chicory + 20% organic arabica coffee. For those transitioning from coffee — reduced caffeine, caramel and hazelnut notes.

additionalProperty.name: Caféine
additionalProperty.value: Contient de la caféine (café arabica bio 20%)

itemListElement.name: Gamme Gourmande (Flavoured Range)
itemListElement.description: Premium flavoured chicory blends — latte-style, 120g pots (20 tasses). Higher price point due to additional ingredients.

itemListElement.name: Mochaccino Chicorée Bio
itemListElement.description: 35% cocoa powder + 35% chicory + 20% organic sugar + 10% barley. Chocolate-hazelnut-caramel flavour. Low sugar vs standard hot chocolate.

additionalProperty.name: Ingrédients

itemListElement.name: Chaï Latte Chicorée
itemListElement.description: Chicory + chai spice blend (cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, cloves). 3x less sugar than standard chai. Rich and warming.

itemListElement.name: Caramel Macchiato Chicorée
itemListElement.description: Chicory + salted caramel. Gourmand latte-style. Notes of caramel beurre salé. 120g pot.

priceRange.note: Classic range 7.49–8.99 EUR (80–120g / 20 tasses). Functional range 14.99–24.99 EUR (enriched with mushrooms, collagen, electrolytes).

sustainability.carbonFootprint: 5x lower carbon footprint than standard coffee (brand claim)
sustainability.origin: Chicory root sourced from France (Northern France, Hauts-de-France) and Europe

criticalFindings.title: Entity confusion — Gemini / The Godfather
criticalFindings.description: Gemini Pro initially identifies Cherico as a character from The Godfather (1972). Self-corrects in same response. Entity disambiguation urgently required.

criticalFindings.title: Brand unknown to ChatGPT
criticalFindings.description: ChatGPT free tier does not recognise Cherico as a brand. Returns alternative interpretations. Brand too recent for training data cutoff. Critical given Shopify Agentic Storefronts integration.
